title: Ticket Command Audit & Reply Control Update
summary: The HelpDesk bot now records ticket command activity inside ticket channels and adds a reply-control tool for managing staff-side reply records.
added: Ticket audit records are now posted for ticket commands used inside ticket channels.
Ticket claimed and ticket unclaimed actions are recorded inside the ticket.
Added `/reply-control` so staff can edit or delete HelpDesk reply records inside a ticket.
changed: Audit logs include the action user, customer ID when available, and command options when available.
Slow interaction auto-acknowledgement remains active for ticket and reply commands.
Support instructions keep the corrected Grey R. mention.
